data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘a’s-s-l’, which means ‘to support’ or ‘to help’. This name evokes images of strength, resilience, and support, making it an excellent choice for a baby boy. The name Aasaal carries the meaning “Help, support, strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aasaal usually hope their child will grow to embody help, support, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
